deadline.value: December 15 (year inferred); international documents must be received by then. Later applications considered only if positions remain. Dept also calls Dec 15 the priority date.
deadline.quote: The deadline for application submission for this program is December 15 (all applicants). | International student applications and supporting documents must be received by the graduate applications office no later than December 15.

also.quote: The priority date for admission is December 15.

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE highly recommended for Fall 2027; no minimum; full consideration without it
gre_subject.quote: Effective for the Fall 2027 application cycle, submission of the physics subject GRE score is highly recommended and submission of the general GRE score is optional. We impose no minimum scores and we will give full consideration to applications without GRE scores.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the page checked

funding.value: PhD package typically provides full funding (TA/RA stipend plus tuition waiver covering most tuition)
funding.quote: Our Ph.D. program offers a generous financial assistance package that typically provides full funding for our students.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a recognized four-year bachelor's degree with GPA of at least 3.0; a master's is not mentioned as required.
entry_route.quote: Graduation from a recognized four-year college, university, or institute of technology.

app_fee.quote: Application fee of US $70.00. You will pay this fee at the time you submit your online application.

fee_waiver.value: Department states no fee waivers are granted

gre_general.value: General GRE optional for Fall 2027; no minimum scores; full consideration without GRE
gre_general.quote: Effective for the Fall 2027 application cycle, submission of the physics subject GRE score is highly recommended and submission of the general GRE score is optional. We impose no minimum scores and we will give full consideration to applications without GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80; IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 100 (TOEFL code 1324, dept code 76)
toefl_min.quote: Official Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) score report. A minimum score of 80 on the internet-based IBT TOEFL is required. Our TOEFL institution code is 1324, Dept. Code 76.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 minimum (alternatively TOEFL iBT 80 or Duolingo 100).
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score report. A minimum score of 6.5 is required.

notes: Domestic-applications page lists graduation from a recognized four-year college and GPA 3.0 on transcripts. Separate Astrophysics, Chemical Physics and Mathematical Physics PhDs exist.
